title: Logarithmic Lefschetz fixed point formulae and resonant boundary indices
summary: We study boundary contributions to the holomorphic Lefschetz formula for strict self-maps of compact complex manifolds with a simple normal crossings divisor. At a normally non-resonant boundary fixed point, the local term reduces to the fixed-point problem on the boundary stratum and vanishes in the de Rham specialisation.
